summary: This static site collects nothing on its own. Analytics load only after an explicit choice, and no page contains a form, a chat widget, or any intake field.

events.name: page_view
events.trigger: A page loads while analytics consent is granted.
events.data: Page path, referrer, coarse region, device class.

events.name: email_click
events.trigger: A visitor activates a mailto: link.
events.data: The path the link was activated from.

events.name: phone_click
events.trigger: A visitor activates a tel: link.
events.data: The path the link was activated from.

events.name: privacy_preference
events.trigger: A visitor allows or declines analytics.
events.data: The chosen preference, stored in this browser only.

events.name: external_embed_load
events.trigger: A visitor presses the button that loads a video embed.
events.data: The path the embed was loaded from.

processors.name: GitHub Pages
processors.data: Standard web server request logs, held by GitHub.

processors.name: Google Analytics 4
processors.role: Aggregate traffic measurement, loaded only after consent.
processors.data: Page views and the link events above, with IP anonymization and no advertising signals.

processors.name: YouTube
processors.role: Video playback on education pages, loaded only when a visitor presses the load button.
processors.data: Playback requests to youtube-nocookie.com after the visitor opts in.

neverCollected: Health information, intake details, or anything a visitor types
Session recordings, heat maps, or scroll tracking
